assets.potions: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual transparent game prop for Abyssals top-down fantasy RPG shop. Reference style: ornate turquoise and cream limestone medieval merchant palace, carved dark walnut, brushed antique gold, illustrated high-detail 3D pre-rendered game asset. Orthographic camera centered directly facing front, looking down at 45 degrees, parallel horizontal front edges (NOT a diamond isometric footprint). Single standalone object fills image, entirely isolated with genuine transparent background; no room, floor, wall, people, UI, lettering or text. Crisp readable silhouette, subtle ambient occlusion and small attached contact shadow. A wide glass-fronted apothecary display cabinet, three shelves of jewel-like red, blue, green and amber potion bottles with cork stoppers. Dark walnut carved frame, turquoise inlaid panels, fine gold trim, substantial plinth and visible depth. Wide and low, width twice its total rendered height.
